name: claude-ultra-motion
description: Ultra pipelines for Claude Code: Ultra Motion Design (free local motion-design video: HyperFrames + GSAP, Manim, Blender, Kokoro TTS, whisper.cpp captions, FLUX.1 schnell, FFmpeg) and Ultra 3D (Blender, build123d/OpenSCAD CAD, Meshy AI meshes, glTF-Transform web GLBs, Bambu Studio slicing).

plugins.name: ultra-motion
plugins.description: Asks 'Ultra Motion Design pipeline or default mode?' for any motion video request; Ultra runs script → directions → storyboard → VO → captions → animation → reviewed frames → multi-format delivery, on free tools only.

plugins.name: ultra-3d
plugins.description: Asks 'Ultra 3D pipeline or default mode?' for any 3D design/modeling request; Ultra runs brief → routing (CAD / Meshy / Blender) → concept checkpoint → build → mesh checks → reviewed renders → per-track exports (renders, web GLB, print + P2S slice, rigged).
